title: Tourist Season, 2001
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: A tourist asks Wood where the locals go. He tells the truth. It's a laundromat.

panels.composition: The laundromat. WOOD restocking the digest rack. A TOURIST in a sun hat, lost, with a map of the coast.

balloons.text: Where do the locals go? The real place.

image.prompt: a laundromat with a young man restocking a free-paper rack, a tourist in a sun hat holding an unfolded coast map, brush-pen black and white

balloons.text: Tuesdays. The dryers on the left are faster.

image.prompt: close-up of a young man answering a tourist with complete sincerity in a laundromat

panels.composition: The tourist taking a digest from the rack, since it's there. Opening it.

image.prompt: a tourist in a sun hat standing in a laundromat reading a small stapled zine from the free rack

panels.composition: The tourist gone, digest under her arm. Wood at the rack. The first reader he's watched take one. He didn't draw it. He's still looking at the door.

image.prompt: a young man standing by a free-paper rack in a laundromat looking at the door someone just left through, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen over rough blue pencil; xerox grain; stark spotting; rain in frantic vertical hatching (Arc 1's aesthetic)

notes: The first reader he sees take a digest. A tourist. He doesn't draw it.
